twofa.title: Protect your Oria account
twofa.body: Set up two-factor authentication now? It takes about 30 seconds and makes your account much harder to compromise.

privacy.q_email_a: Only if you connect it, and only to read. Oria looks for subscriptions, bills, flights, and bookings. It never sends, deletes, or changes anything in your inbox.
privacy.q_sell_a: No. Never. We don't sell it, rent it, or hand it to advertisers.
privacy.q_who_a: You, and anyone you explicitly invite. Our operators only look when you ask for support or we are investigating abuse.
privacy.q_delete_a: Yes. One click in Settings and it is gone within seconds. Backups clear within seven days.
privacy.q_encrypt_a: Yes, both while it is stored and while it is moving. Email tokens get their own separate key.
privacy.details_subtitle: For the technically curious: the full, binding policy.
